method: At each change of support: gravity in the holder frame, the contacts that can push back, the open direction of escape, and the result with power removed. Animated paths are prescribed; this review does not replace a free-piece simulation.

rows.support: Carpet in front of the bumper, under the belt module
rows.resisting: Carpet; belt module bottom 3 mm above the undeformed piece
rows.disposition: accepted: no custody is claimed before the belt grips

rows.support: Vertical belt pinch against the bumper face
rows.resisting: Belt in front and bumper cover behind, both 3 mm from the undeformed piece; grip needs compression
rows.powerOff: Drops back to the carpet outside the robot, the safe direction
rows.disposition: open F2: the belt's bottom pulley must start the lift by compressing the piece's top-front; measure compression, cover friction and lift speed

rows.support: Top of the climb, under the top roller
rows.resisting: Top roller 3 mm above, belt in front, bumper behind
rows.escape: Back down the pinch if the roller stalls
rows.disposition: open F2: the roller must carry the piece over the bumper's top edge

rows.resisting: Side walls to 715 mm, front lip to 170 mm, front upper wall from 482 mm, rear wall
rows.escape: Forward over the lip through the 312 mm throat under hard braking; over the walls if heaped above them
rows.disposition: open F6: drive a loaded hopper through 0.5 g stops and count losses

rows.resisting: Cleat behind, belt below, neighbouring pieces
Hood below and behind, flywheel above
rows.powerOff: Rests on the hood lip inside the robot; the hood begins inboard of the pinch, so the lowest point of the lane is inside
rows.disposition: restrained; the F2 compression setting decides launch, not retention

rows.support: Hood wrap to release at -152 deg
rows.gravity: Along the hood toward the pinch
rows.escape: Released by design at the hood end

rows.support: Robot hanging on two hooks at 70 mm
rows.gravity: Robot pitches rear-down about the rung
rows.resisting: Jaws on the rung's far side and the front bumper on both uprights (about 610 N horizontal at 67.6 kg) across 6.4 mm of overlap per upright
rows.escape: A 6.4 mm lateral offset loses one upright; the rung leaves the throat if the jaw does not reach below its equator
rows.powerOff: The winch must hold 663 N without power
rows.disposition: open F4: widen the bumper overlap (for example a 714 mm wide frame within the 2794 mm perimeter) or add lateral guidance, and lengthen the jaw beyond 5.4 mm below the rung centre
